FN-6Y54913-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 125
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/23/2026
Senate Bill 125 as introduced would decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
by an estimated maximum of $52,000 annually for Fiscal Year 2027 through Fiscal Year 2031
by establishing a refundable, non-transferable income tax credit for the recycling of oyster shell
material. The credit would have an annual cap of $100,000 with a maximum credit of $2,000
per claimant and would sunset after tax year 2030.

FN-6Y54913-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 125
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/28/2026
Senate Bill 125 as reported by the Committee on Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry would
decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated maximum of $52,000
annually for Fiscal Year 2028 through Fiscal Year 2032 by establishing a refundable,
non-transferable income tax credit for the recycling of oyster shell material. The credit would
have an annual cap of $100,000 with a maximum credit of $2,000 per claimant and would
sunset after tax year 2030.
